name: Origin of life on Earth
description: Earliest chemical traces of life; the exact timing and mechanism remain uncertain.

name: Great Oxidation Event
description: Cyanobacterial photosynthesis floods the atmosphere with oxygen.

name: First eukaryotes
description: Cells with nuclei appear, the ancestors of all complex life.

name: Cambrian explosion
description: Rapid diversification of animal body plans in the fossil record.

name: Plants colonize land
description: Early land plants transform continents and atmospheres.

name: First tetrapods walk on land
description: Vertebrates with limbs move from water to land.

name: Permian-Triassic extinction
description: The largest known mass extinction removes most marine species.

name: First dinosaurs
description: Dinosaurs appear in the Triassic and come to dominate land ecosystems.

name: First mammals
description: Small mammaliaforms appear alongside early dinosaurs.

name: Stegosaurus
description: Plated herbivorous dinosaur of the Late Jurassic - closer in time to T. rex than T. rex is to you.

props.source: Gilmore 1914, Osteology of the armored Dinosauria
Seebacher 2001, A new method to calculate allometric length-mass relationships of dinosaurs

name: Archaeopteryx
description: Feathered Jurassic dinosaur long treated as the first bird.

name: Triceratops
description: Three-horned ceratopsian that actually did live alongside Tyrannosaurus rex.

props.source: Alexander 1985, Mechanics of posture and gait of some large dinosaurs

name: Tyrannosaurus rex
description: Apex predator of Late Cretaceous North America and the claims model's favorite demo subject.

props.source: Hutchinson et al. 2011, A computational analysis of limb and body dimensions in Tyrannosaurus rex
Campione & Evans 2020, The accuracy and precision of body mass estimation in non-avian dinosaurs
Sellers et al. 2017, Investigating the running abilities of Tyrannosaurus rex using stress-constrained multibody dynamic analysis
Hutchinson & Garcia 2002, Tyrannosaurus was not a fast runner

name: Chicxulub impact
description: An asteroid roughly 10 km across strikes the Yucatan peninsula.

name: Cretaceous-Paleogene extinction
description: Non-avian dinosaurs and most large vertebrates disappear.

name: First primates
description: Early primates diversify after the dinosaur extinction.

name: Hominins split from chimpanzee lineage
description: The human evolutionary line separates from other apes.

name: Homo erectus
description: First hominin to spread far beyond Africa and master fire.

name: Neanderthals
description: Robust human relatives of Ice Age Eurasia; interbred with modern humans.

name: Homo sapiens
description: Anatomically modern humans, from African origin to the present.

name: Out-of-Africa migration
description: The major expansion of modern humans out of Africa.

name: Humans reach Australia
description: Modern humans cross open water to Sahul.

name: Blue whale
description: The largest animal known to have ever existed.

props.source: Lockyer 1976, Body weights of some species of large whales
Lockyer 1976, Body weights of some species of large whales

name: African bush elephant
description: The largest living land animal - the standard unit of informal comparison.

props.source: Hutchinson et al. 2003, Are fast-moving elephants really running?
